title: Delivery & Pickup Services Fee Schedule: Subscription Fees, Billing Cycles and Past-Due Terms
content:
Every delivery plan of Kestrel Delivery & Pickup Services carries the subscription figures below. The subscription fee is charged per billing cycle in US dollars; a billing cycle runs for the stated number of calendar months; the free trial is counted in calendar days from enrollment before the first subscription fee; the past-due grace period is counted in calendar days after a failed subscription charge before an unpaid plan lapses.

## Schedule

| Term | Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | Kestrel Mail Delivery | Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | Kestrel Specialty Courier Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Subscription fee per billing cycle | $0.00 | $0.00 | $5.99 | $3.99 | $48.00 | $0.00 |
| Billing cycle (calendar months) | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 12 | 0 |
| Free trial from enrollment (calendar days) | 0 | 0 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 0 |
| Past-due grace period (calendar days) | 0 | 0 | 7 | 7 | 14 | 0 |
| Plan prices stop applying while the plan is past due | no | no | yes | yes | yes | no |

A subscription fee of $0.00 and a billing cycle of 0 months mark a plan without a subscription: Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery, Kestrel Mail Delivery and Kestrel Specialty Courier Service charge no subscription fee at all, and their orders carry only the order fees the plan sets.

## Reading the schedule

- **Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly and Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass** both bill every calendar month; the Senior pass is charged $3.99 a cycle and the Monthly pass $5.99 a cycle. Both have a 30-day free trial and a 7-day past-due grace period.
- **Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual** bills once every 12 calendar months at $48.00 a cycle, with a 30-day free trial and a 14-day past-due grace period.
- **Plans without a subscription** show 0 in every row except the fee row, which shows $0.00: there is no trial, no billing cycle and no grace period to count.

## Points of reference

**Is the Annual pass fee charged monthly?** No. The $48.00 is the fee of one 12-month billing cycle.

**Does a plan without a subscription have a free trial?** No. Its free trial is 0 days.

**On which plans do plan prices stop applying while the plan is past due?** On the three Delivery Pass plans: Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly, Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass and Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual.
